**Conversation #113: Routine Weekly Check-in**

Agent: Hi! Weekly check-in from Northline Care. You have your reading handy?

Patient: yeah just took it. BP 146 over 89.

Agent: Got it—logging that for you now. Anything else happening, or just the usual?

Patient: nope just that. feeling ok

Agent: Thanks for checking in. Same time next week?

Patient: yup works

Agent: Perfect. Your reading is logged and the care team will see it. Same time Tuesday. Take care!
